controls.positive: An empty room, no people. Hand-painted anime film background of a warm artist's drafting room in the evening. The left half and centre of the frame is a plain cream plaster wall in soft shadow, almost empty and low in detail. At the right edge a walnut drafting desk with blank cream paper, a brushed-metal desk lamp with amber light and a linen curtain beside a tall open doorway onto a quiet courtyard with a small tree. Charcoal, cream, walnut and amber palette, tactile linen and paper textures. An empty room with nobody in it. Fixed eye-level camera, calm and quiet, hand-painted cel anime film background art. No text, no signs, no logos, no characters, no people, no figures.
